title: A hybrid acoustofluidic device with Parafilm® that operates as a traditional bulk acoustic wave or flexural plate wave device
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,25473-25482
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02351C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Abelino Vargas Jiménez, Diana Carolina Ochoa Cabezas, Michael Delay, Itziar González Gómez, Marcela Camacho
It is present a method for easy construction of hybrid acoustic devices with Parafilm® that can be used as bulk acoustic wave or flexural plate wave device which permits to manipulate cells with different shapes.
